author: CNET
description:
The iPhone Duo, Apple's first foldable phone, is a hot ticket.

Although the phone has an Oct. 23 release date, as of now models preordered through Apple won't ship until the last week of January. The availability at mobile carriers like AT&T, Verizon and T-Mobile is more variable.

CNET Editor in Chief David Katzmaier is here to give a rundown how the 8am ET pre-order went for the team. Did you pre-order an iPhone Duo? #iphoneduo #apple #foldable #iphoneduopreorder #allthingsmobile
title: Behind CNET’s Mad Scramble to Pre-Order an iPhone Duo
